title: Arcana Public Command Surface
description: Authoritative contract linking each public Arcana-shipped slash command to its skill source, invocation home, workflow owner, safety posture, and validation profile.

commands.mutation_behavior: Creates a new grimoire directory, scaffold files, starter chapters, git repository, and library entry.
commands.log_behavior: Writes no log; a grimoire's history is its git history (rites/recent_changes.py renders it).
commands.validation_profile: python rites/validate_grimoire_structure.py --grimoire GRIMOIRE_ROOT; python rites/validate_frontmatter.py --grimoire GRIMOIRE_ROOT; python rites/validate_links.py --grimoire GRIMOIRE_ROOT

preconditions: Material to author, or a file, folder, or inbox to file
commands.mutation_behavior: Authors a page or chapter from a topic or chat answer (stamped by new_page.py), or files a document, folder, or the inbox as chapter-local sources and promotes drafts to pages, then updates affected pages and hubs.
commands.log_behavior: Writes no log; a grimoire's history is its git history (rites/recent_changes.py renders it).
commands.validation_profile: python rites/validate.py --grimoire GRIMOIRE_ROOT structure frontmatter links provenance

preconditions: Source path under chapters/ that exists
Destination path under chapters/ that does not exist
commands.mutation_behavior: Renames or moves a page or chapter under chapters/ via restructure_grimoire.py, retargeting every full-path wikilink that pointed at the moved file(s) and renaming a moved chapter's folder-named hub; the invocation then wires the source and destination hubs, fixes display labels, and logs the move.
commands.log_behavior: Writes no log; a grimoire's history is its git history (rites/recent_changes.py renders it).
commands.validation_profile: python rites/restructure_grimoire.py --grimoire GRIMOIRE_ROOT --move SRC DST; python rites/validate.py --grimoire GRIMOIRE_ROOT links orphans structure

preconditions: Target path under chapters/ that exists
commands.mutation_behavior: Deletes a page or chapter under chapters/ via restructure_grimoire.py and reports every inbound wikilink that would break; the invocation confirms the deletion, drops the parent hub pointer, repairs or removes the broken inbound links, and logs the removal. Refuses to delete a chapter hub on its own.
commands.log_behavior: Writes no log; a grimoire's history is its git history (rites/recent_changes.py renders it).
commands.validation_profile: python rites/restructure_grimoire.py --grimoire GRIMOIRE_ROOT --remove PATH; python rites/validate.py --grimoire GRIMOIRE_ROOT links orphans structure

preconditions: Clean Arcana worktree before a bare update
commands.mutation_behavior: Bare: follows the UPDATE.md procedure (pull Arcana with git --ff-only, then summon.py --update --apply to reconcile the library, pull every grimoire, reset and sync skills, refresh marked agent blocks, and heal grimoires confirmed current). Scoped: skills runs sync_skills.py, library runs sync_library.py, agentfile runs inject_agent_file.py plus the judgment edit for review targets.
Reads the generated Arcana skill catalog and the active grimoire's own skill frontmatter; presents the /grm-* family and the grimoire's own skills.
commands.log_behavior: Does not append grimoire or Arcana logs.
commands.validation_profile: python rites/sync_docs.py --apply when Arcana skill frontmatter or command-surface metadata changes.

commands.mutation_behavior: Runs the deterministic Arcana validator suite, optionally narrowed by selector; parallel mode may refresh transient rite artifacts.
commands.log_behavior: Does not append grimoire or Arcana logs.

commands.mutation_behavior: Deletes known temporary rite artifacts; dry-run previews removals.
commands.log_behavior: Does not append grimoire or Arcana logs.

preconditions: Clean Arcana worktree before a bare update
commands.mutation_behavior: Bare: follows the UPDATE.md procedure. Scoped: skills runs sync_skills.py for Arcana and every installed grimoire, library runs sync_library.py, agentfile runs inject_agent_file.py plus the judgment edit for review and project-level files.
May edit Arcana source, docs, tests, skills, and generated artifacts after reading current context.
commands.log_behavior: Updates CHANGELOG.md for user-visible Arcana changes.
commands.validation_profile: python rites/validate.py --parallel; python -m pytest; python rites/sync_docs.py --apply when generated docs change.

commands.mutation_behavior: Reads generated Arcana skill catalog and locally registered grimoire skill frontmatter.
commands.log_behavior: Does not append grimoire or Arcana logs.
commands.validation_profile: python rites/sync_docs.py --apply when Arcana skill frontmatter or command-surface metadata changes.

preconditions: A repository URL (join) or a folder under the grimoire home (adopt)
commands.mutation_behavior: Conversational onboarding. Reads summon.py --check, then joins a grimoire by link through install_grimoire.py (clone into the home, register in library.json, sync skills), adopts a folder through adopt_grimoire.py plus sync_library.py, or hands off to /grm-create.
commands.log_behavior: Writes no log; a grimoire's history is its git history (rites/recent_changes.py renders it).
commands.validation_profile: python rites/summon.py --check --format json; python rites/validate.py --grimoire GRIMOIRE_ROOT --summary

preconditions: Registered active grimoire that is a git repository
commands.mutation_behavior: Plans the changes to share, then under --apply stages everything git tracks, commits with the composed message, pulls --rebase from the upstream, and pushes. Aborts the rebase and keeps the local commit on conflict; never force-pushes.
commands.log_behavior: Writes no log; a grimoire's history is its git history (rites/recent_changes.py renders it).
commands.validation_profile: python rites/save_grimoire.py --grimoire GRIMOIRE_ROOT --format json (plan runs validate.py --grimoire GRIMOIRE_ROOT first)

commands.mutation_behavior: Read-only by default: the full health pass or a mechanical validator selection surfaces findings; naming and boundaries are judgment reviews reported in chat. Writes only under the fix scope (repair_links.py --apply after a dry run) or when the user approves a specific fix in the health pass.
commands.log_behavior: Writes no log; a grimoire's history is its git history (rites/recent_changes.py renders it).
commands.validation_profile: python rites/validate.py --grimoire GRIMOIRE_ROOT; python rites/repair_links.py --grimoire GRIMOIRE_ROOT (dry run)
